meta.title: feat: Used ShadowDOM in CustomWidget
meta.body_summary: Replace iFrame-based rendering with ShadowDOM in CustomWidget for better isolation and performance, as an experimental feature.

perf_labels.notes: Devin replaced iFrame with ShadowDOM for isolation and performance; no review feedback, PR closed after 8 days without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1334 changed lines across 6 files, this is a medium-sized refactor. As an experimental frontend optimization PR, it was closed without merge, likely due to lack of review engagement or maintainer decision not to pursue the ShadowDOM approach at this time.

review_details.concern_detail: No review feedback received; the PR was marked experimental and no maintainer review was completed. The only human interaction was a deploy-preview build command.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved performance by removing iFrame overhead and using ShadowDOM for better isolation.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after 8 days without review or merge; experimental feature may not have been pursued.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent delivered a functional ShadowDOM refactor, but the PR closed without human review, suggesting process friction for experimental changes in a large repo.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling; manual testing steps only mentioned as required.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without fix; no regression check.

core_change_summary.description: In CustomWidget component, replaced iFrame-based rendering with ShadowDOM by attaching a shadow root and injecting widget content/scripts into it; updated event handling from postMessage to CustomEvents dispatched within shadowRoot; bridged appsmith object into shadowRoot context.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file changes reflect updated event dispatching; reset.css minor tweak.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: replace iFrame with shadowRoot, use CustomEvents, type interfaces.
Formatting and lint fixes by Devin and maintainer.
Subsequent fix commits: properly scope JS execution and events to shadowRoot, bridge appsmith object into shadowRoot context.
